learning.why: Teacher asked me directly why I moved 1 first, making me think about the order rule I just repeated, showing me that (1,4) isn't the same as (4,1).

end.summary: Practised reading and plotting points from ordered pairs (x, y).
end.parentNote: Harsh practised moving along the x-axis first and then the y-axis, using signs to identify quadrants. They correctly explained that (3, 2) and (2, 3) lead to different locations later in the lesson, though the same mix-up appeared earlier. At home, ask them to plot both points on graph paper and label each movement.
